neighbours.label: the exclamation mark '!' ending an excited or emphatic utterance
fire: When we finally reached the summit, Dad shouted, “We made it!” and hugged everyone.
Thanks so much for the lovely gift! It arrived just in time for the party.
The waiter brought out a cake with candles and everyone yelled “Surprise!” at once.
Is there any cure for this? Yes, there is! Most patients recover within a week.
Great presentation today! Only one small note about the third chart.
She opened the box and gasped, “Puppies!” before scooping one up.
Our bakery is finally open on Sundays! Come by for fresh bread.
The coach clapped his hands and said, “Fantastic effort, team!” after the drill.
quiet: When we finally reached the summit, Dad said quietly that we had made it and hugged everyone.
Thanks for the gift, which arrived just in time for the party last weekend.
The waiter brought out a cake with candles and everyone sang softly at the table.
Is there any cure for this? Yes, there is one. Most patients recover within a week.
Good presentation today; only one small note about the third chart.
She opened the box and saw two puppies, then scooped one up.
Our bakery is now open on Sundays, so come by for fresh bread.
The coach nodded and told the team the drill had gone fairly well.
